purpose: private matching of two supplier quotes against a client cap
subjects: accounts of any kind; in the example they are agents

exposure.participants: public: accounts appear in ledger records
exposure.outputs: protected until released under a view to a named audience
exposure.timingAndLinkage: public: which account requested, executed, approved or attested what, and when
exposure.releases: public: that a view was released to an audience; the released content is not on the ledger

release.finality: a holder contributes only when the block of its own attestation is final under the rule of the chain
